div.head: V Atr 1.2
div.ab: ⁊ þæt man frið ⁊ freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde.
⁊ þæt man frið ⁊ freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde.
⁊ [þæt] man frið ⁊ freondscipe rihtlice healde [innan þysan earde for Gode ⁊ for worolde.]
And þæt man frið and freondscype rihtlice healde innan þysan earde for Gode and for worolde.
and that peace and good-will shall be duly maintained [within this land in matters both religious and secular].
And that peace and friendship be justly preserved in this land before God and the world.
and that peace and friendship are to be rightly maintained in both religious and secular concerns within this country.
und dass man Frieden und Freundschaft innerhalb dieses Landes in Geistlichem und Weltlichem rechtlich halte.
and that peace and friendship be lawfully maintained within this country in matters both spiritual and secular.
